insights.summary: Skerries is ahead of last year YTD at €14,691,712.12 (+€301,549.35, +2.1%), while Balbriggan is behind at €11,980,923.12 (-€277,481.92, -2.3%), mainly because transactions are down 20,114 (-3.0%). Both stores are losing scan margin YTD (Balbriggan -€72,543.16, Skerries -€36,518.71), and waste is rising (+19.0% and +9.2%). Palmerstown has no KPI data today because the export file never appeared.

stores.name: Balbriggan
stores.headline: YTD sales €11,980,923.12, down €277,481.92 (-2.3%) on last year, but last week helped with WTD sales up 4.4%
wins: Last week helped the YTD trend: WTD sales were €72,579.92 (+€3,026.07, +4.4%), with WTD transactions up 51 (+1.3%).
YTD average spend is €18.59, up €0.13 (+0.7%), so basket size is holding even with fewer shoppers.
WTD scan margin was €12,582.67, up €392.45 on last year, at a rate of 19.0%.
watch: YTD transactions are 652,316, down 20,114 (-3.0%). This is the main driver of the sales gap and may reflect competitor activity or the back-to-school routine.
YTD waste is €182,709.19, up €29,109.88 (+19.0%). WTD waste is up 13.5% and the latest day is up 40.1% (€874.13), so it is still getting worse.
YTD scan margin is €1,998,322.43 at 18.3%, down 0.2 pts and €72,543.16 on last year.
stores.action: Hold on to last week's footfall recovery by pushing family-basket promotions and weekday meal deals to keep transactions growing. At the same time, carry out a daily waste review of fresh, bakery and deli ordering, as waste is up 19.0% YTD.

stores.name: Skerries
stores.headline: YTD sales €14,691,712.12, up €301,549.35 (+2.1%) on last year, and last week added to that with WTD sales up 5.6%
wins: YTD sales are up €301,549.35 (+2.1%), and WTD sales of €99,041.24 (+€5,227.22, +5.6%) strengthened the trend.
YTD average spend is €23.82, up €0.40 (+1.7%). WTD average spend was €23.56, up 5.2%.
YTD transactions are 621,567, up 2,308 (+0.4%), so footfall is holding after the summer tourist season.
watch: YTD scan margin is €2,360,508.77 at 17.4%, down 0.7 pts. That is €36,518.71 lower than last year despite higher sales. WTD margin rate was 17.6%, down 0.3 pts, so the rate slippage is continuing.
YTD waste is €181,179.04, up €15,274.62 (+9.2%), and WTD waste of €1,244.67 was up 15.0%.
WTD transaction growth was only +0.4%, so recent sales growth depends on spend per basket rather than more shoppers.
stores.action: Review the promotional and category mix to find what is diluting the margin rate, which is down 0.7 pts YTD. Rebalance displays and shelf space towards higher-margin lines. Also scale fresh ordering back from summer levels to curb waste, which rose 15.0% last week.

group_actions: Get the Palmerstown KPI export fixed today so its YTD position can be reviewed alongside the other two stores.
Run a group-wide waste push this week, covering fresh ordering, markdown timing and a daily waste log review. Waste is up €29,109.88 at Balbriggan and €15,274.62 at Skerries YTD.
Protect scan margin across the group by checking promotional depth and supplier costs. YTD margin is down €72,543.16 at Balbriggan and €36,518.71 at Skerries.
